key_features: No-ads clean playback guarantee with default Adsterra blocks stripped
Netflix-inspired Hero Banner with Play, My List bookmark, and Share trigger
Horizontal poster carousels with hover preview expansion, ratings, tags, and play action
Watch Player Page with embedded iframe + interactive Drag & Drop Server Switcher
Live Online Users Pill Counter initialized with base 12-18 users and subtle real-time heartbeat
TV & Anime Episode Browser with Season selectors and Subbed/Dubbed toggles
Share Sheet / Modal supporting WhatsApp, Telegram, X, Facebook, Direct Link Copy
Instant Search Overlay with live filter tags (Movies, TV, Anime, Action, Sci-Fi)
My List / Bookmarks stored in persistent localStorage
Admin Server Management dashboard for drag reordering, adding custom server endpoints, and toggling servers
Responsive Mobile Layout with Sticky Glass Header & Bottom Navigation Bar

component_structure.header: Glassmorphic top bar with logo, nav links (Home, Movies, TV, Anime, My List), Live Online Counter, Search button, and Admin link
component_structure.hero: Full-bleed backdrop gradient overlay, animated headline, badge tags, quick play and share buttons
component_structure.content_rows: Horizontal swipable rows with back/next controls, hover zoom poster cards with title overlay
component_structure.watch_page: Responsive aspect-video player container, draggable server list for priority switching, server health indicators, episode selection grid
component_structure.admin_page: Clean table of active servers, toggle switches, priority order drag handles, server endpoint test trigger
component_structure.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile viewports (Home, Explore, Search, My List, Admin)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code uses standard JavaScript React syntax (.js / .jsx files).
Use lucide-react icons for UI elements (Play, Plus, Share2, Search, Server, GripVertical, Tv, Film, Sparkles, User, Check, ShieldCheck).

Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements: `data-testid='hero-play-button'`, `data-testid='server-item-{id}'`, `data-testid='share-button'`, `data-testid='search-input'`, `data-testid='live-counter'`.
Keep ad blocks completely disabled/removed. Show clear badge '100% Ad-Free Direct Stream'.
Make server drag and drop smooth using Framer Motion reorder or HTML5 drag-and-drop fallback.
